## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I wrote this menu data myself (seen at the place, or from a printed menu I photographed myself).
- [ ] I did **not** copy it from Google Maps, Zomato, Swiggy, any other app or website.
- [ ] I did **not** copy OpenStreetMap tags or coordinates; OSM is referenced by `id` only.
- [ ] I release this data under **CC0-1.0** (public domain).
- [ ] No personal data: no names, phone numbers, emails, links or photos of people.
- [ ] `last_confirmed` is the date I saw these prices (not in the future).
- [ ] `npm run format` and `npm run validate` pass locally.
